description: This Power BI China map component aims to conduct in-depth regional analysis of your metrics, such as company annual sales/user activity/market penetration rate, through geospatial visualization. Visualization dimension: The map is rendered in units of provincial-level administrative regions (including provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government) in China. Data encoding: Use color gradients (such as from light to dark) to map the size of data values, with darker areas representing higher values for the indicator. Core functions: Global Overview: Clearly identify data hotspots and high potential/low-lying areas nationwide. Interactive exploration: Click on any province on the map to drill down and view detailed data for that province Analytical value: This component helps decision-makers quickly grasp the geographical pattern of business development, providing intuitive data support for resource allocation, market strategy formulation, and performance evaluation.
